post.description:
Standard Foundry RAG pinned to one generation.

The generation is verified before any retrieval or generation call, and
again before the result is returned. A result is never published against
a generation other than the one requested.

Start a run pinned to the generation the user was shown. Returns at once
with a `running` record; poll the run for its result.

get.description:
Pass `next_cursor` back with the same `query` and `generation_id` to get
the next page of the same match set.
